metrics.name: Return on Equity
metrics.formula: (revenue - cogs - opex - depreciation - amortization - interest_expense - taxes) / total_equity
metrics.description: Net income as percentage of shareholder equity. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization. Denominator is period-end equity; average beginning/ending equity externally if the balance moves materially within a period.

metrics.name: Return on Assets
metrics.formula: (revenue - cogs - opex - depreciation - amortization - interest_expense - taxes) / total_assets
metrics.description: Net income as percentage of total assets. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization. Denominator is period-end assets.

metrics.name: Return on Invested Capital
metrics.formula: (revenue - cogs - opex - depreciation - amortization - taxes) / (total_debt + total_equity)
metrics.description: NOPAT as percentage of invested capital. NOPAT is approximated as EBIT minus reported taxes (rather than EBIT times one minus a marginal tax rate). With a deductible interest expense and otherwise identical tax assumptions, this overstates operating ROIC by the interest tax shield divided by invested capital. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization.

metrics.name: Return on Capital Employed
metrics.description: EBIT as percentage of capital employed. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization.
